# Bank Accounts (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Bank Accounts` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 1 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-account-bank) | `GET /ref/account/bank?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Bank={Bank}` |


Bank Accounts CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Bank Accounts
| Property           | Type     | Length | Required | Notes                 |
|:-------------------|----------|--------|----------|-----------------------|
| `AccountID`        | Guid     |        |          | Unique ID             |
| `Bank`             | String   | 512    |          | Bank name             |
| `AccountName`      | String   | 256    |          | Account name to which the Bank Account is linked |
| `AccountNumber`    | String   | 256    |          | Account number        |
| `AccountCode`      | String   | 50     |          | Account code to which the Bank Account is linked |
| `Currency`         | String   | 3      |          | Currency              |
| `StatementBalance` | Decimal  |        |          | Statement balance     |
| `BalanceInDear`    | Decimal  |        |          | Cin7 Core balance          |
| `InitialBalance`   | String   |        |          | Initial balance       |

## Bank Accounts

Path: `/ref/account/bank`

<a id="get-ref-account-bank"></a>
### GET /ref/account/bank?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Bank={Bank}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return accounts with the specific code
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return accounts that start with the specific name
- `Bank` (optional, string): Only return accounts with the specific bank
